prompted_for: Home hero: pure water measured to the decimal, precision stainless (became the Hero with the page's equipment drawing and leader-line callouts to its KeyFacts)
composition: split hero: headline and copy left half, equipment drawing right half
top nav bar with logo, five links and outlined CTA
eyebrow label above a four-line headline
ruler tick strip under the headline
two buttons bottom-left: filled steel-blue and outlined
drawing framed by dimension lines and a dotted bounding box
layout_devices: leader-line callouts from equipment parts to label/value pairs
dimension lines and coordinate labels (X/Y) around the drawing
small waveform readout box bottom-left of drawing
palette: warm off-white/limestone headline and line work
typography: bold condensed grotesk all-caps headline, very large
regular sans body copy in sentence case
label caps with value figures in callouts (units like µS/cm, ppb)
rendering: isometric line art of an open-frame skid
motion_implied: leader lines draw from parts to labels
figures count up to their values
t2i_keywords: split layout headline left drawing right
leader-line callouts with label and value
high contrast cream type on navy
eyebrow label with small grid icon
t2i_prompt: Desktop website hero, 16:9, deep navy background. Left half: small spaced-caps eyebrow, a very large off-white condensed all-caps headline about <CONTENT>, a ruler tick strip beneath it, two lines of body copy and two square buttons, one filled steel blue and one outlined. Right half: an isometric hairline line drawing of the equipment inside a dotted bounding box with dimension lines and coordinate labels, and thin leader lines running to label-and-value callouts with units. Top nav bar with outlined call-to-action. Flat vector, one cool accent, precise engineering blueprint mood.
signature_idea: The hero proves the headline by pinning measured figures straight onto the drawing of the machine.
strengths: callouts turn specs into evidence at first glance
clear split hierarchy and obvious CTAs
blueprint drawing reads as engineered, not marketed
maps cleanly onto Hero + KeyFacts components
weaknesses: heavy condensed caps headline is shouty and off-brand
stainless/WFI framing contradicts the polypropylene PW offer
claims like 'guaranteed to pass' are hype
brand_fit_why: Navy, limestone, one steel-blue accent, square corners and callout figures fit; the bold condensed headline replaces Geist light and the annotation clutter costs calm.
